args.sql:
WITH DynastyBudgetStatus AS (
    SELECT 
        a.artdynasty AS Dynasty,
        SUM(r.conservepriorityscore) AS TotalPriorityScore,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN cm.budgetallocstatus = 'Adequate' THEN 1 END) AS AdequateFundingCount,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN cm.budgetallocstatus = 'Insufficient' THEN 1 END) AS InsufficientFundingCount,
        AVG(cbe.value) AS BudgetEfficiencyValue,
        CASE 
            WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN cm.budgetallocstatus = 'Insufficient' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 
            THEN 'Budget Crisis' 
            ELSE 'Within Budget' 
        END AS BudgetStatus
    FROM 
        artifactscore a
    JOIN 
        riskassessments r ON a.artregistry = r.artrefconcerned
    JOIN 
        conservationandmaintenance cm ON a.artregistry = cm.artrefmaintained
    JOIN 
        "Conservation Budget Efficiency (CBE)" cbe ON a.artregistry = cbe.artifact_id
    GROUP BY 
        a.artdynasty
),
AllDynastiesSummary AS (
    SELECT 
        'ALL DYNASTIES' AS Dynasty,
        SUM(TotalPriorityScore) AS TotalPriorityScore,
        SUM(AdequateFundingCount) AS AdequateFundingCount,
        SUM(InsufficientFundingCount) AS InsufficientFundingCount,
        AVG(BudgetEfficiencyValue) AS BudgetEfficiencyValue,
        CASE 
            WHEN SUM(InsufficientFundingCount) > 0 
            THEN 'Budget Crisis' 
            ELSE 'Within Budget' 
        END AS BudgetStatus
    FROM 
        DynastyBudgetStatus
)
SELECT * FROM DynastyBudgetStatus
UNION ALL
SELECT * FROM AllDynastiesSummary;
